title: Linear Algebra Foundations of Efficient Attention: A Phase Reversal in Rank Collapse Under SVD Compression
abstract: arXiv:2609.06341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear algebra provides the framework of concepts (matrix rank, singular value decomposition (SVD), and eigendecomposition) that modern artificial intelligence employs to encode, compress, and propagate information through neural networks. This paper unifies fourteen separate peer-reviewed works analyzing the usage of these techniques in the context of transformer-based foundation model research, focusing on three areas of the topic: derivations and properties of self-attention matrices' output rank, compression methods that purposefully utilize this phenomenon, and the low-rank key-value (KV) cache projection and its semiseparable-matrix duality to linear attention and state-space structured models. translated_title: 高效注意力的线性代数基础：SVD压缩下秩坍缩的相位反转现象
translated_abstract: 线性代数提供了现代人工智能用于在神经网络中编码、压缩和传播信息的概念框架（矩阵秩、奇异值分解（SVD）和特征分解）。本文统一整合了十四篇经同行评审的独立研究工作，分析了这些技术在基于transformer的基础模型研究中的应用，聚焦于该主题的三个领域：自注意力矩阵输出秩的推导与性质、有目的地利用这一现象的压缩方法，以及低秩键值（KV）缓存投影及其与线性注意力和状态空间结构化模型之间的半可分矩阵对偶性。我们在观察到该文献中一个悬而未决的问题后产生了开展这项工作的动机：上述压缩方法与网络自然秩坍缩之间的相互作用。通过本文，我们报告了一项原创发现，即SVD压缩下秩坍缩的相位反转现象。
tldr: 本文整合了十四篇关于线性代数技术在transformer基础模型中应用的研究，并原创性地发现了SVD压缩方法与网络自然秩坍缩相互作用中的相位反转现象。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies fourteen peer-reviewed works on linear algebra techniques in transformer-based foundation models and reports an original finding of a phase reversal in rank collapse under SVD compression.
